_note: Curated from pylint-odoo v10.x, the Odoo 20.0 test_lint checkers (3 _odoo_checker_*.py, msgs identical to v19), test_lint/tests/eslintrc, web/tooling/_eslintrc.json and repo-root ruff.toml of odoo/odoo 20.0 @ 530bc2789e2f. v20 vs v19: Owl is 3.0.0-alpha.50 (addons/web/static/lib/owl/owl.js; v19 ships Owl 2) - props are declared with useProps, useEffect takes one callback, and eslintrc replaces the 'static props' selector with two useEffect selectors, drops the QUnit global and adds the SIP global; ruff.toml keeps its select list (target-version py312, E501 ignored); `ir.model.access` + `ir.rule` are merged into `ir.access` (security/ir.access.csv); `_sql_constraints` is unsupported (models.Constraint); `api.deprecated` moved to odoo.tools.func.deprecated; read_group takes the aggregates signature; check_access_rights, check_access_rule, _filter_access_rules, _check_recursion, _check_m2m_recursion, toggle_active and Registry.clear_cache are removed; `<tree>` is not a view type; `type="base64"` XML data is deprecated; FontAwesome icon classes are replaced by data-icon; web_editor is replaced by html_editor. Dropped from the v19 set because the premise is false at v20: W8177 (Constraint messages are not wrapped in `_()`), W8178 (Html sanitize defaults to True), W8204 (_sql_constraints tuples), E501 (ignored in ruff.toml). New ids are absent from pylint-odoo 10.0.12 (rule_id_collision null). Rules merged with live-extracted rules when odoo_source_root provided.

rules.message: `unlink()` override does not call `super()`.
`invalidate_cache()` does not exist in v20 - use `invalidate_recordset()` / `invalidate_model()` to drop cached values and `flush_recordset()` / `flush_model()` to write pending changes.
`track_visibility` field attribute renamed to `tracking`. Historical transition: v12 to v13 - update field definition.
`attrs` attribute in XML view removed - use Python-domain `invisible`/`required`/`readonly` directly.
`states` attribute in XML view removed - use `invisible` domain expression instead.
N+1 ORM query in loop: `browse()` or `search()` called inside a `for` loop over records.
Computed field has neither an `@api.depends` decorator on its compute method nor a `depends=` field parameter - it will never be recomputed automatically.
`search()` method override must return a recordset and call `super()`.
Many2one field missing `ondelete` parameter - it defaults to 'set null' (or 'restrict' when required), which may leave orphan references; state the policy explicitly.
`digits=(16, 2)` tuple format - prefer a `decimal.precision` name string (for example `digits='Product Price'`) so the precision stays configurable.
`copy=True` set on a field with a unique SQL constraint - duplication will fail.
`default_get()` override does not call `super()` - default values from other modules will be lost.
`_order` attribute references a field that does not exist in the model.
Static assets declared via `qweb` key - use `assets` key with bundle names.
XPath `position='replace'` removes the target element entirely - verify this is intentional.
View inheritance without `inherit_id` - `<record model='ir.ui.view'>` missing `inherit_id` field.
`<tree>` is not a view type in v20 (`ir.ui.view.type` offers `list`) - use the `<list>` tag, and `list` in `view_mode`.
rules.fix_template: Rename `<tree>` to `<list>` in view XML and `tree` to `list` in `view_mode`.

rules.message: String formatting used in UserError/ValidationError - use lazy args or named placeholders.

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'use-vim-comment': Use of vim comment.
rules.message: `name_get()` does not exist in v20 (removed in v18) - override `_compute_display_name()` instead.
`group_operator` is not translated to `aggregator` in v20 - the argument is reported as an unknown field parameter and ignored; use `aggregator`.

`read_group()` signature changed in v20: it takes `(domain, groupby, aggregates, having, offset, limit, order)` and returns tuples - the `fields`, `orderby` and `lazy` arguments and dict results are gone; use `formatted_read_group()` for web-client dicts.
`@api.deprecated` is removed in v20 - import `deprecated` from `odoo.tools.func`.
Unexpected `var`. Use `let` or `const` instead.
Unexpected `console` statement in production JS.
Reference to undeclared variable.
Variable declared but never used.
OWL template references a component not imported.
Blind exception: do not catch `Exception` without re-raising or logging.
Import block is unsorted or has wrong grouping.
Module imported but unused.
Use modern Python syntax (pyupgrade rules).

Owl 3 templates reach component members through `this.`: a bare identifier in t-on (t-on-click="onFoo" or t-on-click="() => onFoo()") resolves only to a template-scope variable (t-set, loop or slot variable) and is undefined for a component method or prop. Use t-on-click="this.onFoo" or t-on-click="() => this.onFoo()".
Raw contenteditable bypasses the audited editor and its sanitisation. Delegate to the `Wysiwyg` component of `html_editor` (`@html_editor/wysiwyg`).
t-set-slot="body" is invalid under <Dialog>: the body IS the default slot. Put body content in the default slot; only header and footer are named slots.
Possible SQL injection risk - string interpolation used in SQL query. Use parameterized queries instead.
`QUnit` is not a declared ESLint global in v20 (`no-undef` flags it) - JS tests run on Hoot: migrate `QUnit.test` / `QUnit.module` to `@odoo/hoot` (`test` / `describe`).
`ir.model.access` is replaced by `ir.access` in v20 - declare accesses in `security/ir.access.csv` with columns `id,name,model_id,group_id/id,operation,domain` (`operation` is a subset of `crud`).
rules.fix_template: Rename `ir.model.access.csv` to `ir.access.csv` and replace the `perm_*` columns with one `operation` column, for example `crud` or `r`.

rules.message: `ir.rule` is replaced by `ir.access` in v20 - a record rule is an `ir.access` record with a `domain` (a restriction when it has no group).
`registry.clear_cache()` is removed in v20 - call `self.env.transaction.invalidate_ormcache(cache_name)`.

`check_access_rights()`, `check_access_rule()` and `_filter_access_rules()` are removed in v20 - use `check_access(operation)` (raises), `has_access(operation)` (bool) or `_filtered_access(operation)`.
`_check_recursion()` and `_check_m2m_recursion()` are removed in v20 - use `not self._has_cycle()` (or `self._has_cycle(field_name)`).
`toggle_active()` is removed in v20 - call `action_archive()` or `action_unarchive()`.

Deprecated model attribute defined (test_lint fails the module): `view_init`, `_needaction`, `_sql`, `_table_query` and `_execute_sql` are not part of the v20 model API - override `_table_sql` for a SQL-view model and call `self.env.execute_query(...)` for SQL.

`_sql_constraints` is unsupported in v20 (the registry logs a warning and no constraint is created) - declare `models.Constraint(definition, message)` (or `models.Index` / `models.UniqueIndex`) class attributes.
`fields.Html(sanitize=False)` disables HTML sanitization and may allow XSS - keep the default (`sanitize=True`) unless the content is fully trusted.
`type="base64"` for file data in XML records is deprecated in v20 - use `type="bytes"`.
FontAwesome (`fa`, `fa-*`) icon class in a view or template - v20 sets icons with Material Symbols through the `data-icon` attribute (test_lint fails any other icon class).
rules.fix_template: Replace `<i class="fa fa-user"/>` with `<i class="oi" data-icon="person"/>`.

rules.message: Direct import from `odoo.orm` in a module - import from `odoo.api`, `odoo.fields` or `odoo.models` (test_lint fails the module).
`self._cr`, `self._uid` and `self._context` are deprecated in v19 and later - use `self.env.cr`, `self.env.uid` and `self.env.context`.
`start_month`, `end_month`, `start_year` and `end_year` on a `date` search filter are not parsed in v20 - remove the attributes.
Owl 3 `useEffect` takes a single callback: a dependency argument is silently ignored. Read the signals inside the callback, or use `useOnChange(() => [deps], callback)`.
Owl 3 calls the `useEffect` callback without arguments: declared parameters are always undefined.
Owl 3 does not read `static props` - declare `props = useProps({ name: t.string(), ... })` with `t.*` validators from `@odoo/owl`.
